whyItMatters: a Tencent Cloud secret key literal assigned to TENCENT_SECRET_KEY committed to the repository hands the key material to every reader, and key material does not expire on its own.
actions: Retire the exposed key and record the retirement date.
Re-issue a replacement with the narrowest scope that still works.
Load the replacement from a KMS or secret manager at run time.
verification: The retired key no longer verifies or decrypts, and no 16+ character literal remains at this name.
